name: Cihu
source:
Race: Male human
Origin: Laya Village
Hobby: Gambling, lying
Job: Village chief

The Chief of Laya Village, Cihu is famous for his love of fighting and for being a bad liar. In OASE, Cihu can be found in the Colosseum joining the Fighting Contest. 

First appeared in Zeiva's early game series - Genetic Glow.
